summary: Tested the SignalWire US/CA-only changes. Catalog (public + authed), Buy page dropdown (United States, Canada only), header 'in 2 countries' and the landing page (no '17 countries', no UK/France numbers in hero mock) all PASS. BLOCKER: every live number search through the running app (/api/cloudivr-web/numbers/search for CA local, CA toll-free, US 212, US toll-free) returns [] and the Buy page shows 'No numbers available for that search'. Root cause: the supervisor 'nodejs' process has no SIGNALWIRE_PROJECT_ID / SIGNALWIRE_API_TOKEN / SIGNALWIRE_SPACE_URL (they exist only in the tool shell env; backend/.env only has the old API_SIGNALWIRE/TOKEN_SIGNALWIRE). rest.enabled() is false in the app, so the router falls through to the blocked Telnyx (log: 'Telnyx searchNumbers error ... 10009 This user has been marked as blocked'). The new search code itself is correct: run from the shell with the SignalWire env (tests/sw_search_probe.js), CA local -> +1226639xxxx (ON), CA toll-free -> +1844..., US 212 -> +1315... with _areaFallback=true region NY, CA 416 -> ON fallback, US toll-free OK, and every result has _signalwire=true so the web hides fax. The UI fallback note and the result cards / no-fax pill could not be checked end-to-end because the app returned no results.

critical.issue: Always returns numbers=[] in preview: the nodejs supervisor process has no SIGNALWIRE_* env vars, so it uses the blocked Telnyx. Add SIGNALWIRE_PROJECT_ID, SIGNALWIRE_API_TOKEN, SIGNALWIRE_SPACE_URL (and SIGNALWIRE_SIGNING_KEY) to backend/.env (from vault or the shell env), restart nodejs and retest. The bot's number search has the same problem in preview.

minor.issue: Canada toll-free results show region 'US' (country_code region_information comes from SW); AREA_REGION has duplicate keys 713 and 980 (harmless).

When SignalWire is off or returns nothing, it silently falls back to Telnyx (TELNYX_FALLBACK defaults to true) even though Telnyx is blocked, which wastes calls and spams logs. Consider skipping Telnyx when phone-config telnyxNumbersOk is false.

integration_issues.flow: Buy a number search (CA local / CA TF / US 212)
integration_issues.issue: Shows buy-no-results because the backend returns []. This is the env problem above, not a frontend bug. Fallback note and result cards are still to be verified.

issues: The unselected 'Canada' option shows an empty white box instead of the CA flag (the flag shows once Canada is selected).

The Coverage section (Sections.js Coverage, data-testid coverage-section) and landing/Hero.js are not rendered anywhere (dead code). The current landing uses OnePage OneHero. Footer/menu '#coverage' links jump to an empty anchor span. No country-count text appears on the landing page.

action_items: Add the SIGNALWIRE_* env vars to backend/.env so the supervisor nodejs process sees them, restart nodejs, then rerun backend/tests/test_cloudivr_signalwire_countries.py (4 search tests currently fail)
After that, retest the Buy page UI: CA local results, CA toll-free, US 212 fallback note, and no buy-fax-pill
Optional: remove or mount the dead Coverage/Hero landing components and fix the '#coverage' anchor links; fix the Canada flag missing in the dropdown option
critical_code_review_comments: numbers.js /numbers/search correctly forces fax:false for _signalwire results and returns a fallback {areaCode, region}
countries() and phone-config getAllCountries/getMoreCountries correctly gate international countries behind numberSearchUsCaOnly
The Telnyx backup in the provider router is still called while Telnyx is blocked

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login civr.uxtest@example.com / UxTest#2026 at /cloudivr/login (cookie-allow-all first), Buy page at /cloudivr/app/buy. The country select is the first button in buy-search-form, with options role=option. To check whether the nodejs process has SignalWire env, list /proc/<pid of js/start-bot.js>/environ key names only.
rca of the issue: Reproduced: GET /numbers/search?country=CA&type=local returns []. nodejs log shows Telnyx 10009 blocked. /proc environ of start-bot.js has no SIGNALWIRE_* keys, while the tool shell has them. config-setup.js loads only <cwd>/.env and backend/.env, and neither holds SIGNALWIRE_*. Fix: put the keys in backend/.env and restart.
